```{r}
stopifnot(!is.null(params$inputs_path))
inputs <- readRDS(params$inputs_path)
repo_root <- here::here()
evidence_run_id <- if (!is.null(inputs$params$evidence_run$id)) {
  inputs$params$evidence_run$id
} else {
  "partial / unpublished"
}
run_dir_display <- if (!is.null(inputs$params$evidence_run$id)) {
  configured_outputs <- inputs$params$paths$outputs
  if (fs::is_absolute_path(configured_outputs)) {
    configured_outputs <- basename(configured_outputs)
  }
  file.path(configured_outputs, "runs", evidence_run_id)
} else {
  tryCatch(
    fs::path_rel(params$run_dir, start = repo_root),
    error = function(e) params$run_dir
  )
}
selected_status <- inputs$selected_resolution_status
has_selected_resolution <- !is.null(selected_status)
is_judbury_selected <- has_selected_resolution &&
  identical(selected_status$scheme_id, "judbury-analysis-site") &&
  identical(selected_status$scheme_version, "1.0.0-proposed")
```

## Snapshot

- Sites: `r inputs$n_sites`
- Observations (raw rows): `r inputs$n_obs_raw`
- Observations (filtered to active effort days): `r inputs$n_obs_filtered`
- Input schema version: `r inputs$schema_version`
- Evidence run ID: `r evidence_run_id`
- Compatibility label: `r inputs$params$run_id`
- Input mode: `r inputs$params$input_mode`

## Time handling & limitations

Timezone configured: `r inputs$params$timezone`  
Fixed offset hours (ignore DST): `r ifelse(is.null(inputs$params$timezone_fixed_offset_hours), "none", inputs$params$timezone_fixed_offset_hours)`  
Backward-jump threshold (hours): `r inputs$params$time_qc$backward_jump_threshold_hours`

Datetime strings are parsed in the configured timezone. If a fixed offset is set, DST gaps are ignored.
Backward jumps are flagged for review rather than automatically corrected.

```{r}
knitr::kable(inputs$time_qc_summary)
```

```{r}
stopifnot(!is.null(params$time_qc_plot_path))
knitr::include_graphics(params$time_qc_plot_path)
```

```{r}
flagged_rows <- nrow(inputs$time_qc_flags)
if (flagged_rows > 0) {
  knitr::kable(utils::head(inputs$time_qc_flags, 20))
} else {
  cat("No time QC flags detected.")
}
```

**Interpretation (what to conclude):** Time‑QC tables identify potential clock issues (parse failures, DST gaps, backward jumps) for review.  
**Caution (what not to conclude):** Flagged rows are not automatically corrected; interpret downstream timing outputs with these issues in mind.

## Event definition & spacing diagnostics

Operational detection events are defined by clustering detections of the same species at the same site
with a gap threshold of `r inputs$params$event_threshold_minutes` minutes.

```{r}
total_events <- sum(inputs$events_per_day$events)
median_gap <- median(inputs$event_spacing$gap_hours, na.rm = TRUE)
data.frame(
  total_events = total_events,
  median_gap_hours = round(median_gap, 2)
) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

```{r}
stopifnot(!is.null(params$event_spacing_path))
knitr::include_graphics(params$event_spacing_path)
```

Note: the event spacing plot uses a log10 x-axis to resolve short-interval spikes.

**Interpretation (what to conclude):** Short‑interval spikes indicate repeated detections that are collapsed by the chosen event gap.  
**Caution (what not to conclude):** Event counts are sensitive to the chosen gap; compare sensitivity outputs before drawing conclusions.


**Interpretation (what to conclude):** Community matrices summarise detections as presence/absence and event counts by site.  
**Caution (what not to conclude):** These matrices reflect detections, not true abundances; rare or cryptic taxa may be under‑represented.

```{r, results='asis'}
if (has_selected_resolution) {
  cat("\n\n## Selected analysis resolution\n\n")
  if (isTRUE(selected_status$route_eligible)) {
    if (is_judbury_selected) {
      cat(paste(
        "For Judbury, the selected mapping combines 13 physical locations into nine analysis sites;",
        "four coordinates are fixed synthetic midpoints used only for mapping and separation.\n\n"
      ))
    }
    cat(paste(
      "Selected results were derived after physical-location events were fixed; physical covariates were not pooled.",
      "Effort means confirmed active site-days, richness is observed and detection-limited.",
      "Jaccard turnover is descriptive and based on observed presences; it is not standardized for unequal confirmed effort, sampling completeness, or species detectability.\n\n"
    ))
    cat("### Effort and coverage\n\n")
    print(knitr::kable(inputs$selected_effort_coverage))
    cat("\n\n### Community presence\n\n")
    print(knitr::kable(inputs$selected_community_presence))
    cat("\n\n### Observed richness\n\n")
    print(knitr::kable(inputs$selected_observed_richness))
    cat("\n\n### Descriptive Jaccard turnover\n\n")
    print(knitr::kable(inputs$selected_jaccard))
  } else {
    reasons <- unlist(selected_status$reasons, use.names = FALSE)
    reasons <- reasons[!is.na(reasons) & nzchar(reasons)]
    if (!length(reasons)) reasons <- "No eligible selected route was recorded."
    cat(paste(
      "An explicit selected analysis resolution was recorded, but the route is",
      "ineligible for ecological tables. Recorded reasons:\n\n"
    ))
    cat(paste0("- ", reasons, collapse = "\n"), "\n")
  }
}
```

## Trait–environment associations

```{r}
assoc <- inputs$trait_env_associations
assoc <- assoc[order(abs(assoc$rho), decreasing = TRUE), ]
assoc_sig <- assoc[!is.na(assoc$p_adj) & assoc$p_adj <= 0.1, ]
if (nrow(assoc_sig) > 0) {
  knitr::kable(utils::head(assoc_sig, 12))
} else {
  cat("No trait–environment associations pass FDR (BH, 0.1). Showing strongest unadjusted correlations.\n\n")
  knitr::kable(utils::head(assoc, 12))
}
```

```{r}
if (!is.null(params$trait_env_path)) {
  knitr::include_graphics(params$trait_env_path)
}
```

**Interpretation (what to conclude):** Trait–environment correlations identify candidate associations to investigate.  
**Caution (what not to conclude):** Correlations are exploratory and do not imply causation; multiple testing is controlled via FDR.

## Spatial overview (site map)

```{r}
if (!is.null(params$site_map_path)) {
  knitr::include_graphics(params$site_map_path)
}
```

Note: the map background is an interpolated surface from site covariates (default `ndvi`) and is intended for visual context only.
North arrow and scale bar are added by default; site labels are optional via `spatial_map.label_sites`.

**Interpretation (what to conclude):** The map provides spatial context for the sites and covariate gradients.  
**Caution (what not to conclude):** The surface is interpolated from points and should not be treated as a measured raster.

## Relative abundance index (pooled)

RAI is defined as operational detection events per trap night, pooled over total survey effort across all included sites (Poisson confidence intervals).

```{r}
knitr::kable(inputs$rai_species)
```

```{r}
stopifnot(!is.null(params$rai_species_path))
knitr::include_graphics(params$rai_species_path)
```

**Interpretation (what to conclude):** RAI compares relative detection rates across species within this survey.  
**Caution (what not to conclude):** RAI is not an estimate of density and should not be compared across surveys without matched effort and detectability.

## Occupancy (single-season)

```{r}
occ_diag <- inputs$occupancy_summary[, c(
  "species",
  "n_sites",
  "n_sites_detected",
  "n_sites_all_zero",
  "naive_occupancy",
  "naive_occupancy_lower",
  "naive_occupancy_upper"
)]
knitr::kable(occ_diag)
```

```{r}
occ_summary <- inputs$occupancy_summary[, c(
  "species",
  "psi",
  "psi_lower",
  "psi_upper",
  "psi_ci_method",
  "p",
  "p_lower",
  "p_upper"
)]
knitr::kable(occ_summary)
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(utils::head(inputs$occupancy_aic, 12))
```

```{r}
if (!is.null(inputs$occupancy_species)) {
  for (sp in inputs$occupancy_species) {
    fig_path <- file.path(params$run_dir, "figures", paste0("occupancy_pred_", sp, ".png"))
    if (file.exists(fig_path)) {
      knitr::include_graphics(fig_path)
    }
  }
}
```

Note: `psi` in the summary table is the occupancy estimate at mean covariate values (state intercept). `psi` confidence intervals use a profile-likelihood method when available; naive occupancy provides an exact binomial interval based on the number of sites with any detections.

**Interpretation (what to conclude):** Occupancy estimates reflect the probability a site is occupied given imperfect detection.  
**Caution (what not to conclude):** Single-season models assume closure and do not model population change; wide intervals can reflect limited site counts or all-zero sites as much as low detectability.

## Limitations & assumptions

- Datetimes are interpreted in the configured timezone; DST gaps are flagged unless a fixed offset is specified.
- Operational detection events depend on the gap threshold; sensitivity analysis is provided above to assess robustness.
- Diel proportions use the configured method (`flash` or `clock`) and do not account for sunrise/sunset variation.
- RAI reflects relative detection rates, not absolute abundance.
- Occupancy models are single-season and illustrative; uncertainty is constrained by the number of sites and the presence of all-zero sites.
- Trait analyses use cleaned taxa metadata; species with missing trait values are dropped from functional diversity.
- Trait–environment associations are exploratory Spearman correlations on abundance-weighted trait proportions.
- Spatial maps use interpolated site covariates (e.g., NDVI) for context and do not represent continuous measured surfaces.
